fields.description: The clocking terminal / device identifier as it appears in legacy .DAT export rows and in Employee Checkin.device_id (HIKVision) - also this document's own name. Documents are created here automatically when a Clocking * Import job encounters a device not yet listed - see is_attendance.controllers.clocking_import.sync_clocking_machines.
fields.label: Clocking Machine ID

fields.description: Left blank on an auto-added record - set this so the device stops falling through to Employee/Fallback Branch resolution. Not required: a blank Branch here simply means this device contributes nothing to Branch resolution, same as if it weren't listed at all.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Optional - link to this device's own ERPNext Asset record, if it's tracked as a capitalised asset.
fields.label: Linked Asset

fields.description: Where this device physically sits at its Branch (e.g. "Main gate, security office"), or any other free-text note - also where an auto-added record's origin note ("Auto-detected from ...") lands until someone fills in the real location.
fields.label: Location / Notes
